method.render: Accepted Batch 004 render is the base. Rows 567-671 (name) or 567-742 (name and amount) of columns 448-807 are refilled by per-column linear interpolation between clean label rows with matched grain (sigma 0.67); every other pixel is byte-identical to the base. Type: Segoe UI Bold, name 91.6 px with -0.034 em tracking (matched to the base render, IoU 0.86), amount 63.2 px (IoU 0.90). Long names are fitted to the rule width and centred on the original cap band, then raised if needed so a descender stays 9 px above the amount digits. Amounts other than 10 mg are re-set at the base amount size and position. A full-size name with a descender stops the build for a layout review. A name below 70% size that contains a space stacks on two lines with the amount scaled by the same factor, but only when stacking sets the name larger than one line does; otherwise it stays on one line.
method.labels: Front and wrap SVG masters are the Batch 004 v3 templates transformed exactly as Batch 008 build-labels.mjs does (port verified byte-identical on BPC-157 5 mg), plus the compound name, a name size fit for long names, and the side-panel field label PRODUCT CODE.
method.previews: Previews are drawn from the SVG masters by tools/svg_label_render.py with Segoe UI faces (nearest weight, ties to the heavier face) and OpenType pair kerning measured through WPF (tools/wpf_kern.ps1). Against the accepted Batch 004 previews the mean absolute difference is 0.80 (front) and 1.61 (wrap) of 255.

differencesFromBatch008: Wrap side panel field label reads PRODUCT CODE (Batch 008: QUICK ORDER SKU), matching the Session 3 and CLAUDE-2 wording "Product code GEN-GRP-xxxx".
Batch 008 previews resolve font-weight 800 (XENIOS, RESEARCH USE ONLY) to Segoe UI Bold; these previews follow the accepted Batch 004 previews, which resolve it to Segoe UI Black.
No supplier PDF proofs in this batch; the wrap SVG and its preview carry the same proof notes.
The wrap proof id is the exact product code (for example GEN-GRP-0325-WRAP-v1), not code-amount, because code-amount can spell a fragment name that label facts forbid (KISSPEPTIN-10 in C1-002).
changesFromC1001: The build reads its variants (names, amounts, codes, verified label text) from tools/variants.json instead of a constant.
Amounts other than 10 mg (5, 15, 20, 30, 40 and 50 mg here) re-set the amount line: at the base size and position under a one-line name, or inside the stack under a stacked name, as in C1-001.
A full-size name with a descender now stops the build instead of being placed (no name in this batch is one).
Each record carries its label-fact source (reference, file, sha256, verified static text) and any per-compound do-not-print terms.

The wrap proof id and the artworkVersion are the exact product code instead of code-amount (C1-001: IPAMORELIN-10-WRAP-v1 and IPAMORELIN-10-WEB-SUPPLIER-v1), because code-amount spelled KISSPEPTIN-10, a forbidden fragment name; verify_c1.py checks both. C1-001 has no such collision and keeps code-amount.
The batch files were built by the copies in tools/ (tools/build_c1.py build), and verify_c1.py --recompute rebuilds every image from them.

changesFromC1005: None in the build, render or label method: build_c1.py, xr_compose.py, svg_label_render.py, wpf_kern.ps1 and c1_variants.py are byte-identical to C1-005's copies. Since the 2026-11-05 correction (see corrections), write_manifest.py keys the label-fact index by reference, file and SHA-256 and stops unless the index equals the records' label-fact pins, and verify_c1.py checks the same. The kern table covers the strings in this batch.

17 of 17 records have form-neutral label facts: they state the name, the amount in mg, the product code and the classification, and no form. For those records the printed vial and the per-vial amount basis rest on the packaging declaration alone; labelFacts keeps CLAUDE-2's hold note and formBasis cites the declaration.

corrections.change: Metadata only. labelFactSources now lists research-batch-05r2.label-facts.json, SHA-256 4ef1eed93a29da425e11235c8e60dd23fb727b8fe13301115bbb1dbc7ab9560b, which records GEN-GRP-0325, 0327, 0328 and 0344 cite. write_manifest.py keyed that index by Jira reference alone; batches 05r2 and 06 share KAN-59/10906, so the batch 06 entry replaced the batch 05r2 entry. The index is now keyed by reference, file and SHA-256, and write_manifest.py stops unless it equals the distinct label-fact pins of the records. verify_c1.py checks that the index has no duplicate entry, equals the distinct record pins and gives one digest per file. Every record, image, label master and the contact sheet are unchanged.
